title: Nobody knows what they're doing
subtitle: A friendly reminder that we don't know anything
description: A friendly reminder that we don't know anything
html:
Everyone is making things up as they go through life.

Nobody truly knows what they’re doing.

And that feeling you feel—you know, the one where you’re uncertain about things—we all feel that.

It’s called being human.

Even most “experts” are but mere humans too. They too were babies at one point. They were curious kids. Rebellious teenagers. Naive adults.

There’s no guidebook that was given to these people who seem like they know what they’re doing—who seem like they have it all together.

So it might wise to take a grain of salt with basically everything.

It’s perfectly okay to not know.
